$comment: The only hand-curated data in the repo. Source names are truncated upstream at 45 UTF-8 bytes (DEF-10); these are the full official names, keyed by Código Órgão Superior. An entry equal to the source name means 'verified complete' (it happens to be exactly 45 bytes). Add an entry only when the truncated name is unambiguous.
